meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: Claude 会逐个完整通读代码库里的每个源文件,大文件用 Read 的 offset 和 limit 分页读完,以此建立对整个代码库的理解。
howto.when: 当你在新项目或不熟悉的项目上开始工作时,或你说“learn the codebase”“read the codebase”“prime”等时触发。

say.text: 帮我 learn 一下这个代码库
say.note: Claude 会完整读取每个源文件

say.text: 读一遍这个代码库,再回答我的问题
先 prime 这个项目,再帮我改代码
say.note: 会先通读源码再动手改

howto.what_en: Claude reads every source file in the codebase in full, paging through large files with the Read tool's offset and limit parameters, to build an understanding of the project.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you start work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you ask to "learn the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

say_en.note: Claude reads every source file in full

say_en.text: Read the whole codebase, then answer my question
Prime this project before editing code
say_en.note: Reads the source first, then edits
